task.title: P6-147: Gate quick-add PresentSection so it does not show on empty query
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, ⌘K palette and quick-add). Original id: P6-147. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**The quick-add panel shows the collection's entire first page whenever the query is empty** (was `P6-069a`). `PresentSection` has no empty-query gate, so `IN THIS COLLECTION` fills up both when the panel is opened at rest and in the moment after every add clears the field.
